abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack. The cost filter was authored as 'card_condition', a key CARD_IN_ZONE does not read, so it counted EVERY card in the pitch zone regardless of cost. cost_gte is the key that is read.
